title: Kissed Fatty Syrian Meat Wrap
description: A romantic Syrian dish featuring a flour tortilla and stir-fry, this wrap is fatty, chewy, and gluten-free-friendly.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat, adding the olive oil to coat the bottom.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet, cooking until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the sliced bell pepper to the skillet, continuing to cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the diced tomato to the skillet, cooking for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the lamb shoulder to the skillet, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Once the lamb is browned, add the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Reduce the heat to low, allowing the mixture to simmer for 10 minutes.
Warm the flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the meat mixture onto the center of each tortilla and folding the tortilla in half.
Serve the wraps immediately, garnished with additional vegetables if desired.
